import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, shutil
path = '/conf/config.xml'
shutil.copy(path, path + '.bak_alias')
tree = ET.parse(path)
root = tree.getroot()

aliases = root.find('OPNsense/Firewall/Alias/aliases')
if aliases is None:
    opn = root.find('OPNsense')
    if opn is None:
        opn = ET.SubElement(root, 'OPNsense')
    fw = opn.find('Firewall')
    if fw is None:
        fw = ET.SubElement(opn, 'Firewall')
    al = fw.find('Alias')
    if al is None:
        al = ET.SubElement(fw, 'Alias')
    aliases = al.find('aliases')
    if aliases is None:
        aliases = ET.SubElement(al, 'aliases')

import uuid
alias = ET.SubElement(aliases, 'alias', {'uuid': str(uuid.uuid4())})
ET.SubElement(alias, 'enabled').text = '1'
ET.SubElement(alias, 'name').text = 'node3_svc_ports'
ET.SubElement(alias, 'type').text = 'port'
ET.SubElement(alias, 'proto').text = ''
ET.SubElement(alias, 'categories').text = ''
ET.SubElement(alias, 'updatefreq').text = ''
ET.SubElement(alias, 'content').text = '8080\n8443\n9000'
ET.SubElement(alias, 'description').text = 'antrieb: node3 service ports'

filt = root.find('filter')
rule = ET.SubElement(filt, 'rule')
ET.SubElement(rule, 'type').text = 'pass'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'ipprotocol').text = 'inet'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'protocol').text = 'tcp'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'descr').text = 'antrieb: allow node2 to node3 on named service ports'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'interface').text = 'opt1'
src = ET.SubElement(rule, 'source')

dst = ET.SubElement(rule, 'destination')
ET.SubElement(dst, 'address').text = '10.60.2.10'
ET.SubElement(dst, 'port').text = 'node3_svc_ports'

tree.write(path, xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')
print('alias+rule added')
PY
